name: Recover the Key!
summary: At Jintha'alor, Elder Torntusk is shackled and asks you to free him. Hitah'ya the Keeper holds his key in a guarded cave nearby.

sections.title: The Keeper's Cave
sections.body: After Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!, you find Elder Torntusk shackled at Jintha'alor. Hitah'ya the Keeper keeps the key to his bindings in a nearby cave, where she is well guarded. Elder Torntusk asks you to kill her and bring back the key. Then he can loosen his shackles and return home.

sections.title: Elder Torntusk's Thanks
sections.body: With the key, Elder Torntusk gets to his feet. He thanks you and says the Revantusk will hear of your deeds.

faq.q: Who holds the key to Elder Torntusk's shackles?
faq.answer: Hitah'ya the Keeper holds the key to Elder Torntusk's shackles. He says she is in a nearby cave, where she is well guarded.
Elder Torntusk is held at Jintha'alor.

faq.q: Why does Elder Torntusk need the key?
faq.answer: The key opens Elder Torntusk's shackles. He says he can return home once he is free.
